landing.metaDescription: Embedded/IoT and Software/Mobile graduation project support for university students — from consultation to full execution and defense prep.
landing.heroTitle: Ship your graduation project with senior engineers
landing.heroSubtitle: Whether you are building Embedded/IoT hardware or a Software/Mobile system, we help your team deliver a defensible project — on time.
landing.tracksSubtitle: Pick the path that matches your college and supervisor expectations.
landing.hardwareDesc: Arduino, ESP32, sensors, firmware, and physical deliverables your examiner can inspect.
landing.hardwareDeliverables: Circuit schematics · Firmware · Assembled hardware · 3D casing · Connection diagrams
landing.softwareDesc: Full-stack web, cross-platform mobile, APIs, and staging demos ready for defense.
landing.softwareDeliverables: Source code · Architecture docs · Database schemas · Live staging demo
landing.servicesSubtitle: Choose how much execution you want from us — pricing is quoted per project.
landing.svcConsultDesc: Architectural review, component selection, troubleshooting, and code review.
landing.svcPartialDesc: We build complex sub-modules, circuits, or APIs while your team owns the rest.
landing.svcFullDesc: End-to-end from requirements analysis through final defense preparation.
landing.howSubtitle: A clear path from idea to defense.
landing.step1Desc: Submit the form. We check technical viability and clarify scope.
landing.step2Desc: Personalized pricing, scope definition, and deposit agreement.
landing.step3Desc: Progress through six structured milestones with visibility.
landing.step4Desc: Code/report delivery, hardware handover, and presentation support.
landing.showcaseSubtitle: Selected student projects we helped bring to defense.
landing.showcaseEmpty: Showcase coming soon — register your project and be among the first.
landing.faq1A: Your team retains ownership of the project IP. We grant you full rights to submit and defend the work.
landing.faq2Q: Will this match my supervisor requirements?
landing.faq2A: Yes — we align deliverables with your course rubric and supervisor feedback throughout the milestones.
landing.faq3Q: Do you buy and ship hardware components?
landing.faq3A: We can advise on BOMs and assemble kits. Component purchasing/shipping is arranged case by case in the quotation.
landing.faq4Q: Do you do code walkthrough sessions?
landing.faq4A: Yes. Walkthroughs are included so every team member can explain the design in the defense.
landing.faq5A: After quotation, a deposit invoice starts the project; final payment is invoiced at delivery. Amounts are set per project — never hardcoded packages.
